decision.explanation: The sources explicitly identify three distinct positions held by Comte de Digoine. D1S2 and D1S6 confirm he was the 'sub-prefect of Fontainebleau'. D2S3 states he was a 'member of the Australian House of Representatives' in 1885. D2S6 mentions his 'previous life as a diplomat in the French Foreign Service', which constitutes a former position. Other candidates like 'French official' (D1S2) or 'French aristocrat' (D2S3) describe his status or origin rather than a specific held office/position, while others (e.g., 'representative of Melbourne North') are inferred details not explicitly stated as a formal title in the text.
